messages:
anya: quick pulse — ran speculative decode on the new 13B-quant nightly build (int8 dynamic). daytime labels look ok but we saw odd early-stop behaviour on short prompts. anyone seen this pattern?
matt: curious, what do you mean by early-stop? tokens cut off or low-prob mass?
anya: tokens cut off — model sometimes emits <EOS> at token ~12 for a 40-token target on canned prompts. not all runs, ~6% of cases.
devon: could be sampling temperature + quant noise. what's the sampling config?
anya: default sampler (top-p 0.95, temp 0.9) + speculative decode enabled (2-stage, speculative size 4). quant was int8 dynamic with per-channel calibration.
olivia: did you try lowering temp? that usually reduces spur EOS from noise. also check KV cache fold — quant sometimes corrupts attention keys at edges.
anya: ran a quick A/B: temp 0.7 drops failure to 2%, temp 0.5 ~0.5%. but end-to-end quality hits (BLEU/ROUGE-like tests) dip a bit.
matt: hmm. that suggests sampling amplifies quantization jitter. maybe speculative decoder's early accept threshold is too aggressive for quantized model.
anya: good call. I instrumented the speculative accept heuristic. in failures, stage1 logits already had an EOS logit > threshold and stage2 confirmed. lowering accept_thresh from 0.6 -> 0.8 reduced failures but latency up 6ms p95.
perfbot: run 3234567921 finished: p50 latency 32ms, p95 78ms, speculative accept rate 18%, failure-rate (truncated EOS) 0.06. artifacts: s3://redwood-test/3234567921/logs.tar.gz
devon: can you paste a minimal failing input? also any pattern in tokens preceding EOS?
anya: pasted one inline: "Write a short haiku about coffee in the office" -> output ends at "cup\n" (EOS). token sequence before EOS: [coffee, in, the, office, \n, \n] — weird extra newline token then EOS.
olivia: newline token then EOS could be a tokenizer boundary issue after quantization (subtoken id shift). did you re-run tokenization mapping post-quant?
anya: mapping stable when using HF tokenizer v0.12, but we use the trimmed vocab for deployment. will repro with full vocab.
matt: aside: for rollout risk, maybe run a gated canary: disable speculative for the first 1k requests on new model or fallback to FP16 for short prompts.
anya: plan: 1) rerun tokenization check with full vocab, 2) increase accept_thresh for quantized builds, 3) run a 10k request canary with speculative off for short prompts, 4) collect prompt-level metrics and diff against FP16 baseline. starting now.
devon: add a quick eval harness to classify truncated outputs vs genuine short outputs so we can auto-alert.
anya: yep -- throwing together a tiny regex+LM-check that flags outputs where EOS appears before expected length and perplexity jumps > 2x compared to baseline.
perfbot: new canary started 3234567950: variant=13b-int8-spec-tweak, sample=10000, expected duration ~2h. will post summary when done :hourglass:
